# Lattice Designer - implant design report

> Design demo, not a medical device. Bone and load numbers are placeholders (source: TODO); nothing here is a clinical, safety or regulatory claim.

## Summary

- Length 160.0 mm, cell size 5.5 mm, interface plates 0.6 mm
- Mass about 393.5 g (geometry only: shell volumes times the material density; overlaps counted twice, so an upper bound)
- 2% of the volume is lattice, 98% solid or plate
- 73,588 triangles

## Zones

| zone | range (mm) | kind | stress (MPa) | candidate | solver-verified (infinite lattice) | finite-block estimate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| tip | 0-44 | solid | 169 | - | - | - |
| mid stem 1 | 44-72 | solid | 81 | - | - | - |
| mid stem 2 | 72-94 | lattice | 41 | j_1fe70241_d_a4635870 | stiffness z 10.00 GPa, strength z 53.3 MPa | 12.44 GPa (beam_model_estimate) |
| neck | 94-160 | solid | 19 | - | - | - |

## How to read the numbers

- **solver_verified_infinite_lattice**: Stiffness and strength of each lattice zone's chosen cell, from the periodic beam solver (an infinite lattice).
- **beam_model_estimate**: Stiffness of a finite block of the zone with welded end plates, from a small beam model that reuses the solver's element code. An estimate.
- **geometry_only**: Mass, volume, strut and triangle counts, measured on the meshes. Not a solver result.
- **not_modelled**: Interface plates, the skin and anything outside the zones are not part of any stiffness or strength number.
